Yeh guard cells hain; beech ka khula raasta stomatal pore hai.
Guard cells pore ko kholne-band karne mein madad karte hain.

Curved cells mein radial lines dikh rahi hain; neeche usi illustration ka halka reflection hai.
Leaf ko hawa se gases exchange karni hoti hain, aur yeh pore unka raasta banta hai.
Lekin isi raaste water vapour bhi bahar ja sakti hai.
Isliye do cells ka kaam poore plant ke gas exchange aur water loss se jud jaata hai.

says: Abhi humne cells ka kaam poore plant se joda; biology ko samajhne ke bhi alag perspectives, ya nazariye, hote hain.
Levels of organisation ka matlab hai molecules aur cells se lekar poore organism aur usse bade groups tak dekhna.

Ecology inhi relationships ki padhai hai.
Cellular and molecular nazariya cells aur unke molecules ke level par explanation dhoondhta hai.
Physiology poochhti hai ki living organism ke kaam kaise chalte hain.
Biochemistry un kaamon mein molecules aur chemical reactions ko samajhti hai.
Historically, yeh perspectives apparently irreconcilable lage: maano inhe aapas mein jodna mumkin na ho.
Lekin garden plant ka surroundings se relation aur uske cells ki working ek hi living system ki complementary explanations hain.

terms.meaning: Ek hi cheez ko samajhne ke alag nazariye.

Poore organism ke level par.
Cells aur unke molecules ke level par.
Organisms ke aapas mein aur surroundings se relationships ki padhai.
Living organisms ke kaam kaise chalte hain, iski padhai.
Living systems ke molecules aur chemical reactions ki padhai.
Upar se aisa lagna ki dono explanations ko joda nahi ja sakta.

points.outside_book: Organism, cell aur molecule ke prerequisite meanings; garden plant se complementary scales ka clarification.

says: Isi connected nazariye se Unit 4, Plant Physiology, mein flowering plants ke physiological processes padhenge.
Flowering plants woh plants hain jinmein flowers bante hain; physiological processes unhe chalaye rakhne aur badhne wale kaam hain.
Pehla chapter Photosynthesis in Higher Plants hai: light ki madad se organic food banana.
Agla, Respiration in Plants, food jaise substances ko todkar usable energy paane ka process samjhayega.
Phir Plant Growth and Development mein plant ka badhna aur uske form aur functioning mein changes padhenge.
Explanation molecular hogi, lekin molecules ko cells aur whole plant ki activities se jodkar dekhenge.
Jahan zaroorat hogi, environment, yaani aas-paas ki conditions, ka relation bhi samjhenge.
points.screen: Unit 4 ke teen chapter cards: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants; Respiration in Plants; Plant Growth and Development. Neeche molecules–cells–plant–environment ka connected framework.

terms.meaning: Organism ko chalaye rakhne aur badhne mein madad karne wale kaam.
Plants jinmein flowers bante hain.
Light ki madad se organic food banane ka process.
Food jaise substances ko todkar usable energy paane ka process.
Plant ka badhna aur life mein uske form aur functioning ka badalna.
Aas-paas ki conditions jo plant par asar daalti hain.

says: Photosynthesis mein food kaise banta hai, yeh samajhne ki kahani mein Melvin Calvin ka important role hai.
Calvin ka janm Minnesota mein April 1911 mein hua.
Unhone University of Minnesota se Ph.D. in Chemistry ki, yaani Chemistry mein original research ki advanced degree li.
Woh University of California, Berkeley mein Professor of Chemistry rahe.
Plant ke food-making process ko samajhne mein Chemistry ka nazariya bahut kaam aaya.
points.screen: Melvin Calvin biography timeline: April 1911, Minnesota → Ph.D. in Chemistry, University of Minnesota → Professor of Chemistry, University of California, Berkeley.

terms.meaning: Chemistry mein original research karne ki advanced degree.

says: World War II ke turant baad Hiroshima-Nagasaki bombings aur radiation ke harmful effects duniya ke saamne the.
Isi daur mein Calvin aur unke co-workers ne radio-activity ko beneficial research mein use kiya.
Radio-activity mein kuch unstable atoms apne-aap radiation nikaalte hain.
Instruments is radiation ko detect kar sakte hain.
Isse plant ke andar atoms ka raasta follow karne ke liye ek pehchaan mil sakti hai.
points.screen: Post-World War II timeline se beneficial research tak connection; unstable atom se radiation signal aur detector ka simple diagram.

terms.meaning: Kuch unstable atoms se apne-aap radiation nikalna.

points.outside_book: Radiation detect karne wale instruments aur detectable tracer ka prerequisite samjhaya.

says: Calvin ne J.A. Bassham ke saath green plants mein sugar aur doosre substances banne ki reactions investigate ki.
Plants carbon dioxide, water aur minerals jaise raw materials lete hain; raw materials nayi cheezein banane ke starting substances hain.
Minerals plant ke functioning aur growth ke liye zaroori inorganic nutrients hain; yeh ready-made sugar nahi hain.
Researchers ne carbon dioxide ko C¹⁴ se label kiya.
Labelling ka matlab pehchaanne layak marker lagana, taaki aage uska raasta pata chale.
C¹⁴ carbon ka radioactive isotope hai, jiska mass number 14 hai.
Isotopes ek element ke aise forms hain jinke atoms mein neutron numbers alag hote hain.
Carbon dioxide ka carbon sugar jaise products ka hissa ban sakta hai.
Products mein radioactive carbon detect karke researchers uske reaction route ke clues paa sake.
points.screen: Calvin aur J.A. Bassham ke naam; C¹⁴-marked carbon dioxide → green plant → separated labelled products. Water aur mineral inputs alag arrows se.

terms.meaning: Starting substances jinse nayi cheezein banti hain.
Plant ki growth aur functioning ke liye zaroori inorganic nutrients.
Pehchaanne layak marker lagana taaki aage ka raasta trace ho sake.
Carbon ka radioactive isotope jiska mass number 14 hai.

points.outside_book: Isotopes ka basic meaning aur separated products mein label detect karke route reconstruct karne ka principle samjhaya.

says: Socho, supplied carbon dioxide mein ek carbon atom C¹⁴-marked hai.
Plant us carbon ko ek naye compound mein jodta hai; marker ab us compound mein milta hai.
Alag times par labelled compounds dhoondhne se pata lag sakta hai ki carbon kin stages se guzra.
Marker carbon ko pehchaanne mein madad karta hai; photosynthesis ko chalane wali energy light se aati hai, C¹⁴ se nahi.
points.screen: Ek highlighted C¹⁴ atom ko carbon dioxide se compound A, phir compound B tak follow karta tracer diagram; light ka separate energy-input arrow.
points.outside_book: Ek labelled atom aur different sampling times ka worked tracer example.

says: Carbon ka raasta ek sawaal tha; light energy chemical work mein kaise badalti hai, yeh doosra sawaal hai.
Calvin ne propose kiya ki pigment molecules aur doosre substances ke organised array mein electron transfer is conversion se juda hai.
Pigment molecules rang wale molecules hain jo kuch light absorb karte hain.
Organised array ka matlab hai components ka kaam ke hisaab se sahi arrangement.
Electron atom ya molecule ka bahut chhota negative-charge wala particle hai.
Chemical energy molecules ki chemical arrangement aur reactions se judi usable energy hai.
Light absorb hone ke baad electron transfer chemical changes ko support kar sakta hai; iska detailed mechanism aage dekhenge.
Is energy-conversion idea ko carbon reactions ki mapping ke saath ek hi cheez mat samajhna.
points.screen: Do separate questions: carbon ka route aur light-energy conversion. Pigment molecules ki ordered row mein light input aur electron-transfer arrows.

terms.meaning: Rang wale molecules jo kuch light absorb karte hain.
Components ka functioning ke hisaab se sahi arrangement.
Atom ya molecule ka bahut chhota negative-charge wala particle.
Molecules ki chemical arrangement aur reactions se judi usable energy.

points.outside_book: Light absorption aur electron transfer ko conceptual overview mein joda; detailed later machinery introduce nahi ki.

says: Labelled carbon ki investigation ne carbon assimilation ka pathway map karne mein madad ki.
Carbon assimilation ka matlab carbon dioxide ke carbon ko plant ke organic compounds ka hissa banana hai.
Pathway ek starting substance se agle products tak pahunchne wali linked reactions ka raasta hai.
Sirf sugar banne ka pata hona kaafi nahi tha; beech ki reactions ka connection bhi chahiye tha.
Photosynthesis mein carbon assimilation ki pathway mapping ke liye Calvin ko 1961 mein Nobel Prize mila.
points.screen: Labelled carbon se connected reaction-route map; highlight: Melvin Calvin — carbon assimilation mapping — Nobel Prize, 1961.

terms.meaning: Carbon dioxide ke carbon ko plant ke organic compounds ka hissa banana.
Starting substances aur products ko jodne wali reactions ka raasta.

says: Calvin se jude photosynthesis ke principles ki value basic discovery tak limited nahi hai.
Inka use renewable resources se energy aur materials paane ki studies mein hota hai.
Renewable resource aisa resource hai jo natural processes se phir ban ya grow kar sakta hai.
Photosynthesis sunlight se plant matter banata hai, isliye energy aur materials research ke liye useful principles deta hai.
Solar energy research, yaani sunlight ko capture aur use karne ki research, bhi in principles se judi hai.
points.screen: Sunlight → plant matter → energy aur materials research ke branches; saath solar-energy research ka connection.

terms.meaning: Resource jo natural processes se phir ban ya grow kar sakta hai.
Sunlight ki energy ko capture aur use karne ki research.

says: Yeh black-and-white portrait Melvin Calvin ka hai, jismein unka upper torso aur face dikhte hain.
Ab is chehre ko photosynthetic carbon assimilation ki mapping aur 1961 ke Nobel Prize se jod sakte ho.
points.screen: Melvin Calvin ka black-and-white upper-torso portrait; naam aur carbon-assimilation mapping ka short identifier.

says: Ab basic sawaal poochho: hum food khate hain, lekin green plants apna food kahan se paate hain?
Green plants apna food synthesise karte hain, yaani starting substances ko jodkar banate hain.
Yeh kaam photosynthesis se hota hai; isliye unhe autotrophs kehte hain.
Autotrophs apna food khud banate hain, lekin unhe bhi bahar se starting materials aur energy chahiye.
Roots se minerals lena food synthesise karne ke barabar nahi hai.
Animals, humans samet, plant-made food par directly ya indirectly depend karte hain.
Food unhe body banane ka material aur functioning ke liye energy deta hai.
points.screen: Green plant ke starting-material aur light inputs; plant-made food se direct aur indirect consumer arrows; roots se mineral uptake ka separate arrow.

terms.meaning: Starting substances ko jodkar koi nayi cheez banana.
Organisms jo apna food khud banate hain.

points.outside_book: Food ke material aur energy roles ka prerequisite briefly samjhaya.

says: Apna organic food banane ka tareeka autotrophic nutrition hai.
Doosre organisms se bana-banaya food paane wale organisms heterotrophs hain.
Plant khane wala animal direct dependent hai; us animal ko khane wala consumer indirectly dependent hai.
Yeh nutritional ability ka distinction hai, sirf plant-versus-animal label ka nahi.
Autotrophic nutrition sirf plants tak restricted nahi hai; kuch bacteria bhi autotrophs hote hain.
points.screen: Comparison table: autotrophic nutrition—food banana; heterotrophs—doosron se food lena. Plant → herbivore → consumer chain; autotrophic bacteria ka additional branch.

terms.meaning: Apna organic food khud banane ka tareeka.
Organisms jo food doosre organisms se paate hain.

points.outside_book: Book ke plants-only generalisation ko correct kiya: autotrophic bacteria bhi hote hain.

says: Ab photosynthesis ki definition ko precise banate hain.
Yeh physico-chemical process hai: light ka physical input chemical reactions ko drive karta hai.
In reactions se organic compounds synthesise hote hain, jaise food mein paaye jaane wale carbon-containing compounds.
Light energy ka input hai; carbon dioxide carbon material ka input hai.
Energy aur material ko alag samjho: light sugar ka carbon nahi ban jaati.
Photosynthesis light energy ko food ki chemical energy se jodta hai.
points.screen: Light energy aur carbon dioxide ke separate input arrows → physico-chemical reactions → organic food aur chemical-energy storage.

terms.meaning: Process jismein physical light input aur chemical reactions dono jude hon.
Carbon-containing compounds, jaise food mein milne wale sugars.

points.outside_book: Energy input aur carbon-matter input ka explicit distinction.

says: Photosynthesis ki importance ke do bade reasons hain: food supply aur oxygen release.
Primary source ka matlab food supply ka starting source; photosynthesis zyadaatar food chains ki buniyad hai.
Plant food banata hai, plant-eaters use lete hain, aur unke consumers tak wahi material aur energy pahunchti hai.
Isi sense mein sunlight ki energy photosynthetic plants se living world tak pahunchti hai.
Doosra, green plants photosynthesis se oxygen atmosphere mein release karte hain.
Atmosphere Earth ko gherne wali hawa hai.
Yeh broad ecological picture hai; kuch specialised ecosystems sunlight ke bajay chemical energy par bhi depend karte hain.
points.screen: Sunlight → green plant → food-chain branches; plant se atmosphere tak separate oxygen arrow. Food supply aur oxygen release ke do highlighted outputs.

terms.meaning: Starting source jahan se food supply shuru hoti hai.
Earth ke aas-paas ki hawa.

points.outside_book: Universal sunlight-dependence claim ko qualify kiya: kuch specialised ecosystems chemical energy par depend karte hain.

says: Socho, agar breathe karne ke liye oxygen hi na ho, toh kya hoga?
Hum breathing se oxygen andar lete hain, lekin uska important use cells ke andar hota hai.
Humare cells respiration mein oxygen ki madad se food se usable energy paate hain.
Oxygen na mile toh yeh energy supply severely affect hogi, aur essential body functions fail ho sakte hain.
Isliye photosynthetic oxygen release ka importance sirf leaf tak limited nahi hai.
points.screen: Atmospheric oxygen → breathing → cells → usable energy → essential body functions; oxygen input hatne par energy supply girti hui.
points.outside_book: Breathing aur oxygen-dependent cellular respiration ka prerequisite connection; answer humans aur oxygen-dependent organisms ke context mein.

says: Ab hum jaante hain photosynthesis kya karta hai; agla sawaal hai, plant yeh karta kaise hai?
Photosynthetic machinery ka matlab hai woh parts aur unka arrangement jo photosynthesis chalate hain.
Aage unki structure aur light energy ko chemical energy mein badalne wali reactions ko jodkar samjhenge.
points.screen: Photosynthesis ke overall input–output map ke beech do connected blocks: machinery ki structure aur energy-converting reactions.

terms.meaning: Photosynthesis chalane wale parts aur unka organised arrangement.

parts.bridge: Pehle apni purani jaankari ko experiments se jodte hain: photosynthesis ke liye kin cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai?
parts.title: Opening

says: Ab apni purani jaankari ko evidence se jodte hain: photosynthesis ke liye chlorophyll, light aur CO₂ ki zaroorat kaise pata chali?
Humne dekha tha ki light energy deti hai aur carbon dioxide carbon material deta hai.
CO₂ carbon dioxide ka formula hai: ek molecule mein ek carbon aur do oxygen atoms hote hain.
Pigment light absorb karne wala rangdaar substance hai; pigment molecules ka idea hum pehle dekh chuke hain.
Chlorophyll leaf ka green pigment hai jo light energy capture karta hai.
Earlier classes ke simple experiments chlorophyll, light aur CO₂ ki requirements dikhate hain.
Yeh recalled requirements ki list hai; iska matlab water unnecessary hona nahi hai.
points.screen: Leaf ke paas teen labelled inputs: chlorophyll—light capture; light—energy; CO₂—carbon. CO₂ molecule mein ek C aur do O spheres. Water ka alag raw-material input.

terms.meaning: Carbon dioxide; ek molecule mein ek carbon aur do oxygen atoms wali gas.
Rangdaar substance jo kuch light absorb karta hai.
Leaf ka green pigment jo light energy capture karta hai.

says: Pehla comparison ek variegated leaf par samjho: is leaf par green aur non-green patches hote hain.
Doosre comparison mein green leaf ka kuch hissa black paper se cover karte hain; black paper us region tak light pahunchne se rokta hai.
Dono comparisons mein starch khojte hain: starch carbohydrate food ka stored form hai.
Naye photosynthesis ka evidence chahiye, isliye pehle plant ko darkness mein rakhkar stored starch use hone dete hain; ise destarching kehte hain.
Variegated leaf ke green patches ka map bana lo, aur covered leaf mein paper ki position mark kar lo.
Ab leaves ko light milne do, phir starch test ke results ko original maps se compare karo.
Teacher ke starch-test demonstration mein leaf ko hot water se treat karke, water bath mein alcohol se green colour hataya jaata hai.
Rinsing ke baad iodine solution add hota hai; starch ho toh blue-black colour milta hai.
Variegated leaf mein illuminated green patches blue-black hote hain; non-green patches nahi hote.
Green leaf ka uncovered region blue-black hota hai; black-paper-covered region nahi hota.
Pehla comparison chlorophyll ki requirement support karta hai; doosra light ki requirement.
Starch photosynthesis ka indirect evidence hai: hum light capture ko directly nahi, usse bani carbohydrate storage ko detect kar rahe hain.
points.screen: Do before–after leaf maps: variegated leaf ke green aur non-green patches; green leaf ka black-paper-covered aur uncovered region. Saath starch-test sequence aur iodine ke blue-black versus yellow-brown results.

terms.meaning: Leaf jismein green aur non-green patches hote hain.
Leaf ke kisi region tak light pahunchne se rokne wala kaala paper.
Carbohydrate food ka stored form.

points.outside_book: Destarching ka purpose, original patch mapping, aur teacher-demonstrated iodine starch-test procedure aur colours explanation ke liye add kiye gaye hain.

says: Ab light aur green colour present rakhkar CO₂ ki requirement test karte hain.
Destarched plant ki ek green leaf ka kuch portion test tube mein enclose karte hain; baaki portion bahar air mein rehta hai.
Tube mein KOH-soaked cotton hoti hai; KOH potassium hydroxide hai, jo yahan CO₂ absorb karta hai.
Cotton leaf ko touch na kare, aur tube ka opening seal rahe, taaki outside air se CO₂ andar replenish na ho.
Dono leaf portions ko light milti hai; tube ke andar wala portion CO₂-deprived hota hai, jabki outside portion ko air se CO₂ milti hai.
Kuch samay baad dono portions ka starch test karte hain.
Outside portion tested positive: starch mila, isliye iodine se blue-black hua.
Tube ke andar wala portion starch-negative rehta hai aur blue-black nahi hota.
Yahan KOH ka role CO₂ hatana hai, oxygen hatana nahi.
points.screen: Ek hi leaf ka portion sealed transparent test tube ke andar, KOH-soaked cotton leaf se alag; baaki leaf outside air mein. Dono par light arrows. Baad mein outside blue-black aur enclosed portion yellow-brown starch-test map.

terms.meaning: Potassium hydroxide; is setup mein CO₂ absorb karne wala substance.
Test mein jis substance ko khoja, woh mila; yahan starch mila.

points.outside_book: CO₂ removal ko effective banane ke liye tube sealing, cotton ko leaf se alag rakhna, aur matched light exposure ki practical clarification add ki gayi hai.

says: Ab batao: in results se CO₂ required hone ka conclusion kaise nikla?
Dono portions green the aur dono ko light mili; important experimental difference CO₂ ki availability thi.
Air-exposed portion mein naya starch mila, lekin KOH se CO₂-deprived portion mein nahi mila.
Destarching ki wajah se purana stored starch result ko explain nahi karta.
Baaki relevant conditions comparable rakhne par CO₂ removal ke saath starch formation ka rukna, CO₂ ki requirement support karta hai.
Isliye conclusion sirf 'tube mein starch nahi mila' nahi hai; conclusion matched portions ke contrast se aata hai.
points.screen: Comparison table: green colour—dono mein; light—dono mein; CO₂—outside available, tube mein removed; starch—outside positive, inside negative. Neeche inference: CO₂ required for photosynthetic starch formation.
points.outside_book: Controlled comparison mein baaki relevant conditions comparable rakhne ka reasoning explicitly samjhaya gaya hai.

parts.bridge: Ab dekhenge ki simple early experiments ne photosynthesis ki understanding ko dheere-dheere kaise banaya.
parts.title: WHAT DO WE KNOW?

says: Abhi humne controlled comparison se CO₂ ki requirement samjhi.
Ab history ko questions ki chain ki tarah dekho: plant hawa mein kya badalta hai, food kahan banta hai, aur oxygen kahan se aati hai?
Simple experiments ne in sawaalon ke answers dheere-dheere jode; har scientist ne understanding mein ek naya connection add kiya.
points.screen: Question-linked timeline: air restoration → sunlight and green parts → food production → effective colours → oxygen source.

says: Joseph Priestley, jinka jeevankaal 1733–1804 tha, ne 1770 mein experiments ki ek series ki.
Inse green plants ki growth mein air ka essential role saamne aaya.
Hum oxygen ka cells ki energy supply se relation dekh chuke hain; oxygen hawa ki woh gas bhi hai jo candle ko jalne mein support karti hai.
Priestley ne oxygen 1774 mein discover ki.
Dono milestones alag rakho: bell-jar experiments 1770 mein, oxygen discovery 1774 mein.
points.screen: Priestley timeline: 1733–1804; 1770—air and plant experiments; 1774—oxygen discovery.

terms.meaning: Hawa ki gas jo breathing se judi cellular energy supply aur candle burning ko support karti hai.

points.outside_book: Oxygen supports combustion, linking the candle observation to the previously taught role in respiration.

says: Priestley ne candle ko bell jar, yaani ghanti ke shape ke glass cover se bani closed space, mein rakha.
Closed jar freely outside air exchange nahi karta; burning candle kuch samay baad bujh gayi.
Isi tarah enclosed mouse suffocate kar sakta tha: breathing ke liye oxygen kam padne se dam ghutna.
Priestley ne ise hawa ka 'damage' hona kaha.
Lekin mint plant saath rakhne par reported result badla: mouse alive raha aur candle jalti rahi.
Unhone hypothesised kiya, yaani observations samjhane ke liye testable explanation di: plants hawa mein woh restore karte hain jo animals aur candles hataate hain.
Restore ka matlab ghati hui cheez ko phir bharna hai.
Hum photosynthesis ka oxygen release se connection pehle dekh chuke hain.
Aaj hum result ko yun samajhte hain: burning aur animal respiration oxygen use karte hain; illuminated green plant photosynthesis se oxygen replenish kar sakta hai.
Plant bhi respiration karta hai; restoration uski light mein photosynthetic activity se juda hai, sirf plant ki presence se nahi.
points.screen: Two closed-jar comparisons with oxygen arrows: candle/mouse consume oxygen; illuminated mint plant adds photosynthetic oxygen.

terms.meaning: Ghanti ke shape ka glass cover jo setup ko closed space mein rakhta hai.
Breathing ke liye oxygen kam padne se dam ghutna.
Observations ko samjhane ke liye jaanchne layak explanation propose ki.
Jo ghat gaya tha use phir replenish karna.

points.outside_book: Modern oxygen interpretation; closed-space gas exchange and the clarification that plants also respire.

says: Figure 11.1 mein Priestley ka comparison do horizontal pairs mein diya hai.
Panel (a) mein closed bell jar ke andar mouse aur burning candle hain; plant nahi hai.
Rightward arrow panel (b) tak jaata hai: candle bujh chuki hai aur mouse collapsed dikhaya hai.
Neeche panel (c) mein leafy potted plant, mouse aur burning candle saath hain.
Iska rightward arrow panel (d) tak hai: plant present hai, mouse upright hai aur candle abhi jal rahi hai.
Pehle a→b padho, phir c→d; dono rows ko compare karke plant-present aur plant-absent outcomes samjho.
Yeh a→b→c→d ki ek continuous sequence nahi hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.1 with (a)→(b) and (c)→(d), highlighting candle flames, mouse posture and plant presence.

says: Socho, kuch din baad candle dobara jalakar restored air test karni ho, toh jar khole bina kaise jalaoge?
Jar khol diya toh fresh air aa jaayegi; phir candle jalne ka reason plant tha ya outside air, yeh separate nahi kar paayenge.
Ek possible design mein lens se sunlight wick par focus karke ignition ki ja sakti hai.
Doosre design mein pehle se fitted, sealed electrical igniter ko outside switch se activate kar sakte hain.
Dono designs ka common idea hai: ignition ho, lekin jar ki air replace na ho.
Yeh teacher-controlled experimental designs hain; historical mouse setup ko diagram se samjhenge, live animal par repeat nahi karenge.
points.screen: Closed plant-and-candle jar with two ignition designs: external focusing lens; sealed electrical igniter and external switch.
points.outside_book: Two possible closed-setup ignition designs and humane, teacher-controlled handling guidance.

says: Priestley ka result agla sawaal chhodta tha: kya plant darkness mein bhi air restore karta hai?
Jan Ingenhousz, 1730–1799, ne similar setup ko darkness aur sunlight mein compare kiya.
Unhone dikhaya ki air restore karne wale plant process ke liye sunlight essential hai.
Yahan 'purifies the air' ka matlab hawa ko phir candle burning aur animal breathing support karne layak banana hai.
Plant passive filter ki tarah har condition mein oxygen nahi bharta.
Isliye Priestley ko restoration-of-air hypothesis se jodo, aur Ingenhousz ko sunlight ki requirement ke experimental demonstration se.
points.screen: Matched Priestley-like setups: dark versus sunlight; sunlight-linked air-restoration outcome.

terms.meaning: Yahan hawa ko phir candle burning aur breathing support karne layak banana.

says: Ingenhousz ne aquatic plant, yaani paani mein rehne ya ugne wale plant, se gas release ko visible banaya.
Bright sunlight mein green parts ke aas-paas chhote bubbles bane; darkness mein yeh bubbles nahi bane.
Green parts chlorophyll wale plant regions hain; bubbles paani ke andar gas ke chhote gole hain.
Baad mein unhone gas ko oxygen identify kiya.
Isse conclusion mila: light mein oxygen release plant ke green parts se hoti hai.
Hum chlorophyll ka light capture karna jaante hain; isi connection se green regions ki photosynthetic activity samajh aati hai.
Darkness mein photosynthetic bubbling ka na dikhna, plant ki respiration rukne ka evidence nahi hai.
points.screen: Unnamed submerged aquatic plant: green regions with rising oxygen bubbles in bright light; matched dark condition without photosynthetic bubbles.

terms.meaning: Paani mein rehne ya ugne wala plant.
Plant ke chlorophyll-containing green regions.
Paani mein gas ke chhote gole.

points.outside_book: Clarification that absence of photosynthetic bubbles does not imply absence of respiration.

says: Air mein change samajhne ke baad ab plant ke food par aao.
About 1854, Julius von Sachs ne growing plants mein glucose production ka evidence diya; glucose ek sugar hai.
Unki later studies ne green substance chlorophyll ko plant cells ke special bodies mein locate kiya, jinhe baad mein chloroplasts kaha gaya.
Chloroplasts cell ke andar chlorophyll rakhne wale organised parts hain.
Sachs ne green plant regions ko glucose formation se joda; bana glucose usually starch ke form mein store hota hai.
Hum starch ko stored carbohydrate aur photosynthesis ke indirect evidence ke roop mein pehle use kar chuke hain.
Ab us test ki biological link clear hai: sugar production aur starch storage related hain, lekin ek hi chemical substance nahi hain.
points.screen: About 1854—Sachs; green leaf → plant cell → chlorophyll-containing chloroplast; glucose → starch storage.

terms.meaning: Plant cell ke andar chlorophyll rakhne wale organised parts.

points.outside_book: Brief prerequisite that glucose is a sugar; detailed chloroplast structure is reserved for the next heading.

says: Ab sawaal badlo: light ke sab colours photosynthesis mein equally effective hain?

Yeh internal features genetic predisposition aur plant ki growth par depend karte hain.
Genetic predisposition matlab inherited genes ki wajah se plant ki structure aur functioning ki tendencies.
Isliye same surroundings milne par bhi different plants, ya growth ke different stages, ek jaisi photosynthetic rate zaroori nahi dikhaayenge.
points.screen: Crop plant se leaf, mesophyll cell aur chloroplast tak connected diagram. Internal factors ki table: leaves aur photosynthetic structures—number, size, age, orientation; internal CO₂; chlorophyll amount. Neeche genetics aur growth se arrows.

terms.meaning: Leaf ya photosynthetic structure kis direction aur angle par positioned hai.
Inherited genes se judi plant ki structure aur functioning ki tendencies.

says: Ab external factors jodo: sunlight ki availability, temperature, CO₂ concentration aur water.
Light energy aur CO₂ carbon supply karte hain, jaisa requirements mein samjha tha; lekin leaf ko saari suitable conditions saath chahiye.
Photosynthesis chalte waqt yeh factors simultaneously interact karke uski rate affect karte hain.
Lekin simultaneous influence ka matlab yeh nahi ki har factor equally rate ko rok raha hai.
Usually ek factor sub-optimal hota hai: process ke liye jitni suitable condition chahiye, usse kam favourable.
Jo factor us waqt rate ko restrict kar raha hai, use limiting factor kehte hain.
Socho, light sufficient hai lekin CO₂ supply inadequate hai; extra light missing carbon supply ki jagah nahi le sakti.
Rate improve karne ke liye pehle pehchaanna padega ki abhi actual restriction kaunsi hai.
points.screen: Leaf tak sunlight, temperature, atmospheric CO₂ aur water ke chaar inputs. Sufficient light ke saath narrow CO₂ input aur restricted carbon-fixation output.

terms.meaning: Process ki requirement ke comparison mein kam favourable condition.
Woh factor jo given conditions mein process ki rate ko restrict kar raha hai.

says: Isi immediate restriction ko Blackman ne 1905 mein Law of Limiting Factors ke roop mein state kiya.
Jab kisi chemical process ko multiple factors affect karein, uski rate woh factor determine karta hai jo apni minimal value ke nearest hai.
Minimal value ko process ki requirement ke relative samjho: available conditions mein sabse restrictive level.
Temperature ke number ko CO₂ percentage se directly compare karke smallest number nahi chunna hai.
Law ka practical test hai: limiting factor ki quantity ya condition badalne par process ki rate directly respond karti hai.
Kisi already adequate factor ko badhaane se current restriction zaroori nahi hategi.
Ek restriction relieve hone ke baad doosra factor limiting ban sakta hai; limiting factor permanently ek hi nahi rehta.
points.screen: Blackman—1905—Law of Limiting Factors. Do controlled changes ki comparison table: adequate factor badhaana → restriction persists; limiting condition improve karna → rate increases, phir possible new limitation.

terms.meaning: Multiple requirements mein jo factor abhi sabse restrictive hai, wahi process ki rate determine karta hai.
Process ki requirement ke relative kisi factor ka sabse restrictive level.

points.outside_book: Unlike units ke raw numbers compare na karne aur restriction relieve hone par limiting factor badalne ki conceptual clarification.

says: Ab NCERT ki green leaf lo: chlorophyll present hai, light optimal hai aur CO₂ conditions bhi optimal hain.
Lekin temperature bahut low hai; aise mein leaf photosynthesise nahi kar paati.
Kya aur light dena solution hoga? Nahi, is stated case mein light already adequate hai; restriction temperature hai.
Stroma ki sugar-forming reactions enzymatic hain, jaisa division of labour mein padha tha.
Enzymes ki reaction speed temperature se affect hoti hai; bahut low temperature required biochemical reactions ko severely slow kar sakta hai.
Ab light aur CO₂ fixed rakho, aur temperature optimal karo.
Optimal temperature woh temperature hai jahan photosynthesis ke liye conditions sabse suitable hain.
Book ke is example mein leaf photosynthesising shuru kar deti hai.
Temperature badalne se response mila; isi se Blackman ke law ka application clear hota hai.
points.screen: Ek green leaf ke do matched panels: optimal light + optimal CO₂ + very low temperature → photosynthesis stopped; same light + same CO₂ + optimal temperature → photosynthesis active. Sirf thermometer setting badalti hai.

terms.meaning: Woh temperature jahan photosynthesis ke liye conditions sabse suitable hon.

points.outside_book: Example ka mechanistic base: enzyme-mediated reactions ki speed temperature se affect hoti hai aur bahut low temperature par slow ho sakti hai.

parts.bridge: Ab light ko alag se dekhenge: uski availability badalne par photosynthesis ki rate kab badhti hai aur kab doosra factor limiting ban jaata hai?
parts.title: FACTORS AFFECTING PHOTOSYNTHESIS

says: Light ka effect samajhne se pehle teen alag controls pehchaano: uska colour, uski brightness aur woh kitni der milti hai.
Light quality ka matlab light ki wavelength ya colour hai; quality yahan achhi ya kharaab light ka judgement nahi hai.
Light intensity bataati hai ki given surface area par per unit time kitni light energy pahunchti hai.
Duration of exposure matlab plant ko light kitni der milti hai.
Socho, lamp ka colour badalna, brightness badhaana aur timer badhaana teen different changes hain.
Aage waala graph intensity badalta hai; colour aur exposure duration uski horizontal axis nahi hain.
points.screen: Teen labelled controls: colour spectrum—Light quality; dim-to-bright lamp—Light intensity; clock—Duration of exposure. Intensity control se graph ki horizontal axis tak connection.

terms.meaning: Light ki wavelength ya colour.
Given surface area par per unit time pahunchne wali light energy.
Plant ko light milne ka total samay.

points.outside_book: Lamp ke colour, brightness aur timer ka comparison teen variables distinguish karne ke liye added example hai.

says: Blackman ka law yaad karo: abhi jo factor sabse restrictive hai, wahi rate determine karta hai.
Low light intensity par light supply limiting hoti hai; incident light badhaane se CO₂ fixation rate approximately proportion mein badhti hai.
Isse linear relationship kehte hain: graph ka rising portion lagbhag seedhi line hota hai.
Lekin intensity badhti rahe toh rate ki increase dheere-dheere kam hoti hai, aur phir further increase nahi hoti.
Ab light ke bajay CO₂ availability ya biochemical reactions ki capacity jaise doosre factors limiting ho sakte hain.
Isliye aur light dena current restriction nahi hataata; constant rate ka matlab photosynthesis ruk gayi, yeh nahi hai.
points.screen: Light intensity ke against CO₂ fixation rate: pehle straight rising segment, phir bend aur horizontal positive-rate segment. Rising segment par light limitation; horizontal segment par other-factor limitation.

terms.meaning: Aisa relationship jiska graph lagbhag seedhi line ho; ek quantity badhne par doosri proportion mein badhe.

points.outside_book: CO₂ availability aur finite biochemical capacity ko possible high-light limitations ke concrete examples ke roop mein joda gaya hai.

says: Abhi dekha ki sufficient light ke baad additional light rate nahi badhaati; is condition ko light saturation kehte hain.
NCERT ke account mein light saturation full sunlight ke 10 per cent par ho jaati hai.
Yaani full sunlight ka lagbhag dasvaan hissa hi is stated saturation level tak pahunchne ke liye kaafi hai.
Isliye nature mein light rarely limiting factor hoti hai; rarely ko never mat samajhna.
Shade ya dense forests mein plants ko kam light mil sakti hai, isliye wahan light limitation important exception hai.
Dense canopy ke neeche ki leaf aur open sunlight waali leaf ko milne waali illumination ek jaisi nahi hoti.
points.screen: Full sunlight ka 100-part bar, pehle 10 parts highlighted as NCERT saturation level. Saath open leaf aur dense forest canopy ke neeche shaded leaf ka comparison.

terms.meaning: Light ka woh level jiske baad additional light se photosynthetic rate further nahi badhti.

says: Ab Figure 11.10 mein isi response ko label by label padho.
Horizontal axis Light intensity hai, right ki taraf increasing; vertical axis Rate of photosynthesis hai, upward increasing.
Dono axes ke positive ends par arrowheads hain.
Origin se curve approximately straight rise karti hai; A isi low-light rising region ko mark karta hai.
Yahan extra light se rate badhti hai, isliye light limiting hai.
B transition region hai: curve bend karti hai aur light badhaane ka additional effect kam hota jaata hai.
C high-light horizontal region hai; is flat portion ko plateau kehte hain.
Plateau par photosynthesis positive, constant rate se chal rahi hai; doosre factors further increase restrict karte hain.
D horizontal axis par saturation-region intensity ka projection hai; vertical dashed line use curve se jodti hai.
E vertical axis par plateau rate ka level hai; horizontal dashed line us rate ko project karti hai.
Curve ke paas thin arrows rising, transition aur plateau regions ko distinguish karte hain.
Isliye D light intensity bataata hai, jabki E photosynthetic rate; dono ek quantity nahi hain.
Graph mein numerical scale nahi hai, isliye D ya E ki numerical value is drawing se calculate nahi kar sakte.
points.screen: Figure 11.10 ka unscaled graph: arrowheaded axes; origin se rising A, bending B, horizontal C; D tak vertical dashed projection aur E tak horizontal dashed projection; regions ke paas thin directional arrows.

terms.meaning: Graph ka flat portion jahan horizontal quantity badhne par vertical quantity further nahi badhti.

says: Lekin saturation aur excessive-light damage ko alag rakho.
Chlorophyll light energy absorb karta hai, jaisa pigments mein samjha tha.
Incident light ek point se beyond badhne par chlorophyll ka breakdown kar sakti hai; tab photosynthesis ki rate decrease hoti hai.
Saturation mein rate constant thi; damage mein rate actually girti hai.
Printed Figure 11.10 plateau tak response dikhaati hai; excessive-light damage ka mechanism ab isse alag samjho.
Toh light ki kami rate limit kar sakti hai, sufficient light saturation de sakti hai, aur bahut excessive light damage kar sakti hai.
points.screen: Do side-by-side panels: saturation—intact chlorophyll aur constant photosynthetic-rate indicator; excessive light—chlorophyll fading aur falling rate indicator. Printed A–E graph alag, unchanged.

parts.bridge: Ab dekhenge CO₂ concentration badhaane par photosynthesis ka response light ki availability aur C₃–C₄ pathway ke saath kaise badalta hai.
parts.title: Light

says: Blackman ka law yaad karo: jo requirement abhi restrictive hai, use improve karne par rate badh sakti hai.
Ab carbon supply dekho: concentration ka matlab total hawa mein CO₂ ka kitna hissa hai.
NCERT atmosphere ki CO₂ concentration 0.03–0.04 per cent deti hai aur CO₂ ko photosynthesis ka major limiting factor bataati hai.
Carbohydrate banaane ke liye carbon chahiye; CO₂ ki limited availability carbon fixation ko restrict kar sakti hai.
Book ke account mein concentration 0.05 per cent tak badhaane se CO₂ fixation rate badh sakti hai.
Lekin isse beyond higher levels par longer exposure damaging ho sakta hai.
Isliye CO₂ badhaana unlimited benefit ka rule nahi; concentration aur exposure ka samay dono important hain.
points.screen: Leaf mein entering CO₂ arrows; NCERT concentration cards: atmospheric CO₂ 0.03–0.04%; enrichment upto 0.05% → fixation rate can increase; higher levels + prolonged exposure → possible damage.

terms.meaning: Total hawa mein CO₂ ka kitna hissa hai.

says: C₃ and C₄ plants, yaani C₃ aur C₄ groups, ko unke first stable fixation products se pehchaante hain; unke pathways hum samajh chuke hain.
Ab dono groups ko same light conditions mein compare karo.
Low light mein extra CO₂ dene par neither group photosynthetic rate mein increase dikhaata hai.
Kyun? Light ki restriction baaki hai; extra carbon supply light reactions ki inadequate energy supply replace nahi kar sakti.
High light intensity par CO₂ badhaane se dono groups ki photosynthetic rates increase karti hain.
Lekin C₄ plants about 360 µlL⁻¹ par saturation dikhaate hain; C₃ plants ki saturation only beyond 450 µlL⁻¹ dikhti hai.
µlL⁻¹ ka matlab har litre hawa mein CO₂ ke microlitres hai.
Yahan saturation matlab aur CO₂ dene par rate further nahi badhti; photosynthesis band nahi hoti.
C₄ ka bundle sheath mein CO₂ concentrate karna yaad karo; uski wajah se comparatively low external CO₂ par bhi RuBisCO ko achhi supply milti hai.
C₃ plants higher external CO₂ se further benefit le sakte hain.
Isi response ke basis par NCERT apne diye atmospheric levels ko C₃ plants ke liye limiting bataati hai.
points.screen: Two-panel CO₂-response diagram: low light—C₃ and C₄ responses flat with added CO₂; high light—both rise, C₄ plateaus near 360 µlL⁻¹ and C₃ plateaus beyond 450 µlL⁻¹. Beside C₄ curve: bundle sheath CO₂ concentration.

terms.meaning: Har litre hawa mein CO₂ ke microlitres.
CO₂ ka woh response level jiske baad additional CO₂ se photosynthetic rate further nahi badhti.

points.outside_book: Previously taught C₄ CO₂-concentrating mechanism is used to explain its earlier saturation with external CO₂. C₃ and C₄ plants were already explained through their first stable fixation products, so their meaning is recalled rather than redefined.

says: Is difference ka farming mein real use dekho: greenhouse mein tomatoes aur bell pepper ugaaye jaate hain.
Yeh C₃ crops higher CO₂ par increased photosynthesis aur productivity dikha sakti hain.
Carbon dioxide enriched atmosphere matlab aisi hawa jismein CO₂ ki concentration badhaayi gayi ho.
In crops ko greenhouse ki enriched atmosphere mein grow karne se higher yields milti hain.
Blackman ka law yaad karo: light hi limiting ho toh sirf CO₂ enrichment photosynthetic rate nahi badhaayegi.
Isliye cultivation mein enrichment ka benefit light aur doosri suitable conditions ke saath judta hai.
points.screen: Greenhouse containing tomato and bell-pepper plants; CO₂ enrichment → increased C₃ photosynthesis → greater productivity → higher harvest yield. Adjacent low-light comparison shows unchanged photosynthetic rate despite added CO₂.

terms.meaning: Aisi hawa jismein CO₂ ki concentration badhaayi gayi ho.

parts.bridge: CO₂ supply ka effect clear hai; ab dekhein temperature photosynthetic reactions aur C₃–C₄ performance ko kaise badalta hai.
parts.title: Carbon dioxide Concentration

says: Ab temperature ka effect samjho; stromal carbon reactions enzymes ki help se chalti hain, jaisa pehle padha tha.
Enzymatic wahi enzyme-assisted reactions ka idea hai; enzyme activity temperature badalne par badalti hai.
Isliye dark reactions strongly temperature controlled hain; light aur CO₂ adequate hone par bhi unsuitable temperature carbon assimilation restrict kar sakta hai.
Light reactions bhi temperature sensitive hain, lekin dark reactions ke comparison mein much lesser extent tak.
Toh directly light-driven hone ka matlab temperature se completely independent hona nahi hai.
points.screen: Chloroplast diagram: stroma mein enzyme-assisted carbon reactions aur thylakoid membranes par light reactions. Thermometer se dono tak arrows; carbon reactions ki taraf stronger temperature-response arrow.

says: Optimal temperature ka meaning yaad hai: photosynthesis ke liye sabse favourable temperature.
Temperature optimum bhi isi best-performing temperature ka naam hai; iska matlab highest possible temperature nahi hai.
C₄ plants comparatively higher temperatures par favourable response aur higher photosynthetic rates dikhaate hain; C₃ plants ka temperature optimum much lower hota hai.
Same suitable light aur CO₂ par qualitative response curves socho: C₄ curve ka peak C₃ ke peak se warmer side par hoga.
C₄ ki local CO₂ supply RuBisCO ki oxygenase activity minimise karti hai, jaisa photorespiration mein samjha tha.
Yeh carbon-loss protection warmer conditions mein C₄ performance ko support karti hai.
Lekin higher optimum ka matlab yeh nahi ki temperature indefinitely badhaate rehne se photosynthesis badhti rahegi.
points.screen: Qualitative graph: horizontal axis Temperature, vertical axis Rate of photosynthesis. C₃ response ka peak cooler side par, C₄ ka warmer side par; dono peaks ke baad declining curves.
points.outside_book: Qualitative temperature-response curves aur optimum ke beyond declining response explanatory additions hain; C₄ CO₂ concentration ko warmer-condition performance se mechanistically joda gaya hai.

says: Ab pathway ke alawa ek aur influence jodo: habitat, yaani woh jagah aur environmental conditions jahan plant rehta hai.
Tropical plants garam tropical regions se adapted plants hain.
Temperate climates generally tropical regions se cooler, seasonal climates hote hain.
Different habitats mein plants different temperature conditions se adapted hote hain; isliye unka photosynthetic optimum bhi same hona zaroori nahi.
Tropical plants ka temperature optimum temperate climates se adapted plants ke comparison mein higher hota hai.
Pichhle comparison mein C₃–C₄ pathway dekha tha; yahan habitat adaptation dekh rahe hain.
Dono comparisons alag rakho: tropical plant ko automatically C₄ label nahi kar sakte.
Isliye saare plants ke liye photosynthesis ka ek universal best temperature nahi hota.
points.screen: Do separate comparison rows: Pathway—C₃ cooler optimum, C₄ warmer optimum; Habitat—temperate-adapted cooler optimum, tropical-adapted warmer optimum. Saath mein temperate seasonal landscape aur tropical vegetation.

terms.meaning: Woh jagah aur environmental conditions jahan plant rehta hai.
Earth ke garam tropical regions se juda hua.
Generally tropical regions se cooler, seasonal climates.

points.outside_book: Tropical habitat ko automatically C₄ pathway na maanne ka clarification dono comparison criteria ko alag samajhne ke liye add kiya gaya hai.

parts.bridge: Ab water ka effect dekhenge: paani ki kami photosynthesis ko plant ki condition aur CO₂ supply ke through kaise affect karti hai?
parts.title: Temperature

says: Water light reaction ka reactant hai; water splitting mein uska role hum samajh chuke hain.
Lekin environmental factor ke roop mein water ka main effect sirf splitting ke liye substrate ki kami nahi, plant ki overall condition ke through hota hai.
Water stress matlab plant ki zaroorat ke comparison mein paani kam padna.
Iske do connected effects dekho.
Pehla, stomata close hote hain; stomata leaf ke gas-exchange pores hain, jinka stomatal pore aur guard cells wala arrangement opening mein dekha tha.
In pores se water vapour bhi nikalti hai; closure further water loss kam karta hai, lekin CO₂ entry bhi restrict karta hai.
CO₂ availability ghatne par carbon fixation aur photosynthetic rate kam ho sakti hai.
Doosra, water stress se leaves wilt karti hain: paani ki kami se dheeli padkar jhuk jaati hain.
Cells ke andar water pressure leaf ko firm rakhne mein help karta hai; paani kam hone par yeh support ghatta hai.
Wilting se leaf ki effectively exposed surface area kam hoti hai; water stress metabolic activity bhi reduce karta hai.
Metabolic activity matlab cells ke andar chalne wali chemical reactions ka kaam.
Toh dono branches jodo: stomatal closure CO₂ supply ghataata hai, aur wilting ke saath reduced surface area aur metabolic activity leaf ki functioning ghataate hain.
Isliye water shortage ka photosynthesis par major effect indirect hai, water ke reactant hone ke bawajood.
points.screen: Two-branch causal diagram: Water stress → stomatal closure → reduced CO₂ entry → reduced carbon fixation; Water stress → wilting → reduced effectively exposed leaf area and metabolic activity → reduced photosynthesis. Beside it, firm and drooping leaves with cell-water-pressure insets.

terms.meaning: Plant ki zaroorat ke comparison mein paani kam padna.
Leaf ke gas-exchange pores; pehle dekhe stomatal pore ka plural naam.
Paani ki kami se leaf ka dheela padkar jhuk jaana.
Cells ke andar chalne wali chemical reactions ka kaam.

points.outside_book: Wilting ka cellular support samjhane ke liye water pressure ka brief explanation add kiya. Reduced leaf surface area ko effectively exposed area ke roop mein clarify kiya.
